full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern with light chorus and delay. A sub-bass synth provides sustained low-end support. The male vocal is a soft tenor, utilizing breathy delivery in the lower register and transitioning to a light head voice for melodic leaps. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the cyclical guitar motif and the vocal melody. Key of C Major. Tempo is 72 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
